audit: Fix for Nonplae cover fallback and compact 10-item alternating changelog

rootCauseInvestigation.screenshotReport: User screenshot showed Top Secret (Bionic Commando), MetaFight (Blaster Master), and Pokémon Crystal Advance Redux displaying 'ภาพปกไม่พร้อมใช้งาน'.
findings: All 3 games had working, verified 200 OK primary covers hosted on nonplae.com (e.g. https://www.nonplae.com/covers/top-secret-th-nonplae-v1.0.webp).
However, their coverAlternatives array contained guessed Libretro URLs that returned 404 (e.g. Top Secret - Hitler no Fukkatsu (Japan).png was 404).
In src/catalog-media.js, coverCandidates(g) checked 'g.coverAlternatives?.length ? g.coverAlternatives : ...' which completely discarded g.cover when coverAlternatives was non-empty.
The browser requested the dead 404 URL, triggering mediaFailed(), and fell back to 'ภาพปกไม่พร้อมใช้งาน'.
resolution: Updated coverCandidates in src/catalog-media.js to always prioritize g.cover / g.coverCandidateUrl as candidate #0 (primary), appending valid coverAlternatives as fallbacks.
Tested all 1,025 distinct URLs across the catalog; identified 255 dead Libretro candidate URLs and purged them from coverAlternatives across 267 games.

Verified in real Chrome via tools/qa_verify_user_screenshot_games.js: Top Secret (naturalWidth=1536), MetaFight (naturalWidth=1536), and Pokémon Crystal Advance Redux (naturalWidth=1536) now all render with real, sharp covers.

changelogEnhancement.styling: Compact box with padding 10px 14px, font-size 12px, line-height 1.45, truncated summaries (max 52 chars).
changelogEnhancement.alternatingColors: Zebra striping on .changelog-row:nth-child(even) with subtle translucent background tint.
changelogEnhancement.actionBadges: Mint green badge for 'อัปเดตเกม' (new full release) and Amber orange badge for 'อัปเดตแก้ไขเกม' (patch update).
